AETHER DESIGN & ENGINE

Built for power listeners.

Unified Provider Search

Search once to discover and stream tracks across your local directories, Spotify playlists, and YouTube audio simultaneously without switching apps.

Bit-Perfect Audio Engine

High-resolution audio pipeline with direct hardware output support for 24-bit FLAC, WAV, and ALAC with zero sample rate degradation.

Tiered Offline Sync

Dedicated downloads view indicated by crisp emerald green tier badges (`#10B981`). Play your offline library anytime with zero telemetry.

Native Cross-Platform

Built with Flutter, high-performance C++ Windows runner, and native Android background audio service for minimal CPU usage and instant startup.
